<style>
/* =========================================================
   FINANCIAL ASSESSMENT REPORT
   Matches reference PDF exactly
   ========================================================= */

@page {
    size: A4;
    margin: 14mm 13mm 16mm 13mm;
}

* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #1e2a3a;
    font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
}

.page {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 265mm;
    position: relative;
    page-break-after: always;
    padding-bottom: 14mm;
}

.page:last-child {
    page-break-after: auto;
}

/* =========================================================
   DEBUG PANEL (REMOVE BEFORE FINAL DELIVERY)
   ========================================================= */

.debug-panel {
    border: 2px dashed #c77700;
    background: #fff8e1;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-family: "Consolas", "Monaco", monospace;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #4a3a00;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.debug-panel h4 {
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #c77700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
}

.debug-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 4px 20px;
}

.debug-row {
    padding: 2px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px dotted #e0c88a;
}

.debug-label {
    color: #8a6a00;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.debug-value {
    color: #1e2a3a;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.debug-source {
    color: #a08000;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* =========================================================
   PAGE HEADER
   ========================================================= */

.page-header {
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
}

.company-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.6px;
}

.report-title {
    font-size: 9.5px;
    color: #7b8a9c;
    margin-top: 2px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.page-title {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    margin: 0 0 4px 0;
    letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}

.page-subtitle {
    color: #7b8a9c;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

/* =========================================================
   COVER PAGE
   ========================================================= */

.cover {
    min-height: 258mm;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.cover-top {
    padding-top: 22mm;
}

.cover-label {
    display: inline-block;
    background: #0f2a4a;
    color: #ffffff;
    padding: 7px 15px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1.4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.cover-title {
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1.12;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    margin: 20px 0 12px 0;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.6px;
}

.cover-client {
    font-size: 17px;
    color: #2c3e56;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.cover-meta {
    margin-top: 26px;
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
}

.cover-meta td {
    padding: 7px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f7;
    font-size: 10px;
}

.cover-meta .label {
    width: 38%;
    color: #7b8a9c;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.cover-meta .value {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1e2a3a;
}

.cover-footer {
    border-top: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    padding-top: 12px;
    color: #7b8a9c;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* =========================================================
   SECTION HEADINGS
   ========================================================= */

.section {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.section-heading {
    color: #0f2a4a;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.7px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #0f2a4a;
}

.section-heading.light {
    background: #f4f7fb;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-left: 4px solid #0f2a4a;
    padding: 8px 11px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* =========================================================
   KPI CARDS
   ========================================================= */

.cards {
    display: table;
    width: 100%;
    table-layout: fixed;
    border-spacing: 6px 0;
    margin: 0 -6px;
}

.card {
    display: table-cell;
    vertical-align: top;
    background: #f7f9fc;
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px 12px 11px 12px;
}

.card-gap {
    display: table-cell;
    width: 6px;
}

.card-label {
    color: #7b8a9c;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.7px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.card-value {
    color: #0f2a4a;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 5px;
    letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}

.card-value.green { color: #1e7a4b; }
.card-value.red   { color: #b03030; }
.card-value.orange{ color: #b07b1a; }

.card-status {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
}

.card-status.good   { color: #1e7a4b; }
.card-status.watch  { color: #b07b1a; }
.card-status.action { color: #b03030; }

/* =========================================================
   DATA TABLES
   ========================================================= */

.data-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.data-table th {
    background: #f4f7fb;
    color: #4a5b73;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 8px 9px;
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    text-align: left;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.data-table td {
    padding: 8px 9px;
    border: 1px solid #edf1f6;
    vertical-align: middle;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    color: #1e2a3a;
}

.data-table tr {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.amount {
    text-align: right;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.center { text-align: center; }
.muted  { color: #7b8a9c; }
.small  { font-size: 8px; }

/* =========================================================
   STATUS BADGES
   ========================================================= */

.badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.badge-good   { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e7a4b; }
.badge-watch  { background: #fdf3e0; color: #a06a1a; }
.badge-action { background: #fde8e8; color: #a02020; }

/* =========================================================
   SUMMARY GRID
   ========================================================= */

.summary-grid {
    display: table;
    width: 100%;
    table-layout: fixed;
    border-spacing: 6px 0;
    margin: 0 -6px;
}

.summary-item {
    display: table-cell;
    background: #f7f9fc;
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.summary-label {
    font-size: 8.5px;
    color: #7b8a9c;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.summary-value {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    margin-top: 5px;
    letter-spacing: -0.2px;
}

/* =========================================================
   CHARTS
   ========================================================= */

.chart-box {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.chart-title {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.hbar-chart { padding: 4px 0; }

.hbar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 9px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
}

.hbar-label {
    width: 140px;
    color: #1e2a3a;
    font-weight: 500;
}

.hbar-track {
    flex: 1;
    background: #eef2f7;
    height: 14px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.hbar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #2e9e8f;
}

.hbar-fill.watch { background: #e6a23c; }

.hbar-value {
    width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
}

.bar-chart {
    height: 130px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-around;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #d4dce6;
    padding: 0 20px;
}

.bar-column {
    width: 22%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: center;
}

.bar {
    width: 42px;
    background: #3d7fa3;
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
    min-height: 3px;
}

.bar-label {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #4a5b73;
    margin-top: 7px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.bar-value {
    font-size: 8.5px;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.donut-wrap {
    display: table;
    width: 100%;
    table-layout: fixed;
}

.donut-cell {
    display: table-cell;
    width: 48%;
    vertical-align: middle;
    text-align: center;
}

.legend-cell {
    display: table-cell;
    width: 52%;
    vertical-align: middle;
    padding-left: 8px;
}

.donut {
    width: 145px;
    height: 145px;
    margin: auto;
}

.legend-item {
    margin: 8px 0;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    color: #1e2a3a;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.legend-dot {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 11px;
    height: 11px;
    margin-right: 7px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.dot-financial  { background: #2e9e8f; }
.dot-realestate { background: #e6a23c; }
.dot-business   { background: #f0c674; }
.dot-other      { background: #ef7d7d; }

/* =========================================================
   CALLOUTS
   ========================================================= */

.callout {
    border-left: 4px solid #0f2a4a;
    background: #f4f7fb;
    padding: 11px 14px;
    margin: 10px 0;
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.callout.warning {
    border-left-color: #e6a23c;
    background: #fdf7ec;
}

.callout.danger {
    border-left-color: #d9534f;
    background: #fdf1f1;
}

.callout.success {
    border-left-color: #2e9e8f;
    background: #eef9f6;
}

.callout-title {
    font-size: 9.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* =========================================================
   RECOMMENDATIONS
   ========================================================= */

.recommendation {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-left: 3px solid #0f2a4a;
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    padding: 11px 13px;
    margin-bottom: 9px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
    background: #ffffff;
}

.recommendation-title {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.recommendation-text {
    margin-top: 5px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    color: #2c3e56;
    line-height: 1.55;
}

/* =========================================================
   FOOTER
   ========================================================= */

.print-footer {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    padding-top: 7px;
    font-size: 8px;
    color: #7b8a9c;
    display: table;
    width: 100%;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.footer-left  { display: table-cell; text-align: left; }
.footer-right { display: table-cell; text-align: right; }

/* =========================================================
   DISCLAIMER
   ========================================================= */

.disclaimer {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    background: #fafbfd;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: #4a5b73;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.disclaimer ul {
    margin: 6px 0 0 0;
    padding-left: 18px;
}

.disclaimer li {
    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

/* =========================================================
   RETIREMENT CORPUS LINE CHART
   ========================================================= */

.retirement-chart-box {
    border: 1px solid #e4e9f0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
}

.retirement-chart-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #0f2a4a;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.retirement-chart-legend {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 9px;
    color: #4a5b73;
}

.retirement-chart-legend span {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}

.legend-line-solid {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 26px;
    height: 3px;
    background: #2e9e8f;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.legend-line-dashed {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 26px;
    height: 0;
    border-top: 2px dashed #d9534f;
}

.retirement-chart-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 220px;
}
</style>


{# =========================================================
   LINKED DOCUMENTS
   ========================================================= #}

{% set income_name = frappe.db.get_value("Income And Expenses", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set income = frappe.get_doc("Income And Expenses", income_name) if income_name else None %}

{% set assets_name = frappe.db.get_value("Assets And Investments", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set assets = frappe.get_doc("Assets And Investments", assets_name) if assets_name else None %}

{% set loans_name = frappe.db.get_value("Loans And Liabilities", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set loans = frappe.get_doc("Loans And Liabilities", loans_name) if loans_name else None %}

{% set insurance_name = frappe.db.get_value("Insurance Coverage", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set insurance = frappe.get_doc("Insurance Coverage", insurance_name) if insurance_name else None %}

{% set goals_name = frappe.db.get_value("Future Goals", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set goals = frappe.get_doc("Future Goals", goals_name) if goals_name else None %}

{% set financial_summary_name = frappe.db.get_value("Financial Summary", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set financial_summary = frappe.get_doc("Financial Summary", financial_summary_name) if financial_summary_name else None %}

{% set advisory_name = frappe.db.get_value("Advisory And Recommendations", {"identifier": doc.name}, "name") %}
{% set advisory = frappe.get_doc("Advisory And Recommendations", advisory_name) if advisory_name else None %}


{# =========================================================
   CORE VALUES
   ========================================================= #}

{% set total_income     = (income.total_annual_income or 0) if income else 0 %}
{% set total_expenses   = (income.total_annual_expenses or 0) if income else 0 %}
{% set annual_surplus   = (income.annual_surplus_deficit or 0) if income else 0 %}
{% set monthly_surplus  = (income.monthly_surplus_deficit or 0) if income else 0 %}
{% set savings_rate     = (income.savings_rate or 0) if income else 0 %}

{% set monthly_income   = total_income / 12 if total_income else 0 %}
{% set monthly_expenses = total_expenses / 12 if total_expenses else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   FINANCIAL SUMMARY
   ========================================================= #}

{% set total_assets      = (financial_summary.total_assets or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set total_liabilities = (financial_summary.total_liabilities or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set net_worth         = (financial_summary.net_worth or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set monthly_emi       = (financial_summary.total_monthly_emi or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}

{% set financial_assets  = (financial_summary.financial_assets_current_market_value or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set real_estate       = (financial_summary.real_estate_assets_current_market_value or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set business_assets   = (financial_summary.business_assets_estimated_market_value or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}
{% set other_assets      = (financial_summary.other_assets or 0) if financial_summary else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   INSURANCE
   ========================================================= #}

{% set total_life_cover       = (insurance.total_life_cover_in_force or 0) if insurance else 0 %}
{% set total_health_cover     = (insurance.total_health_cover_all_policies or 0) if insurance else 0 %}
{% set recommended_life_cover = (insurance.recommended_life_cover or 0) if insurance else 0 %}
{% set life_cover_gap         = (insurance.life_cover_gap_surplus or 0) if insurance else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   LOANS
   ========================================================= #}

{% set debt_to_income = (loans.emi_to_income_ratio or 0) if loans else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   DEBT TO ASSET
   ========================================================= #}

{% set debt_to_assets = (total_liabilities / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   EMERGENCY FUND
   ========================================================= #}

{% set emergency_months = (financial_assets / monthly_expenses) if monthly_expenses else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   LARGEST ASSET CLASS
   ========================================================= #}

{% set asset_classes = [
    ("Financial Assets", financial_assets),
    ("Real Estate", real_estate),
    ("Business Assets", business_assets),
    ("Other Assets", other_assets)
] | sort(attribute=1, reverse=True) %}

{% set largest_asset_share = (asset_classes[0][1] / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   CLIENT PROFILE — FETCHED FROM FAMILY & DEPENDENT DETAILS
   Find the "Self" row and read all profile data from it
   ========================================================= #}

{% set client_profile = namespace(
    name = doc.client_full_name_entity_name or "-",
    age = 0,
    occupation = "-",
    dependents = 0,
    member_found = false
) %}

{# Loop through family rows to find "Self" #}
{% for family_row in (doc.family_and_dependent_details or []) %}

    {% set member_value = (family_row.member or "")|string|lower|trim %}
    {% set relation_value = (family_row.relation or "")|string|lower|trim %}

    {# Match member as "Self" (flexible matching) #}
    {% if not client_profile.member_found and (
        member_value == "self"
        or member_value == "client"
        or member_value == "applicant"
        or relation_value in ["self", "client", "applicant"]
    ) %}

        {% set client_profile.member_found = true %}

        {# Read age from the Self row #}
        {% if family_row.age %}
            {% set client_profile.age = family_row.age|int %}
        {% endif %}

        {# Read occupation from the Self row #}
        {% if family_row.occupation %}
            {% set client_profile.occupation = family_row.occupation %}
        {% endif %}

        {# Read name from the Self row (fallback to parent) #}
        {% if family_row.full_name %}
            {% set client_profile.name = family_row.full_name %}
        {% endif %}

    {% endif %}

    {# Count dependents (any row where dependent = Yes) #}
    {% set dependent_value = (family_row.dependent or "")|string|lower|trim %}
    {% if dependent_value in ["yes", "y", "true", "1"] %}
        {% set client_profile.dependents = client_profile.dependents + 1 %}
    {% endif %}

{% endfor %}

{# Assign to short variables for use in template #}
{% set current_age = client_profile.age %}
{% set client_name = client_profile.name %}
{% set client_occupation = client_profile.occupation %}
{% set client_dependents = client_profile.dependents %}


{# =========================================================
   RETIREMENT READINESS
   ========================================================= #}

{% set retirement_age = 60 %}
{% set years_to_retirement = retirement_age - current_age %}

{# Safety net: keep within realistic range #}
{% if years_to_retirement < 1 %}
    {% set years_to_retirement = 1 %}
{% endif %}
{% if years_to_retirement > 45 %}
    {% set years_to_retirement = 30 %}
{% endif %}

{% set projected_corpus = (
    financial_assets + (total_income * 0.3)
) * ((1.09) ** years_to_retirement) %}

{% set corpus_required = monthly_expenses * 12 * 25 %}

{% set retirement_readiness = (
    projected_corpus / corpus_required * 100
) if corpus_required else 0 %}

{% if retirement_readiness > 100 %}
    {% set retirement_readiness = 100 %}
{% endif %}

{# Guard: don't claim readiness when age is unrealistic #}
{% if current_age < 18 or current_age > 80 %}
    {% set retirement_readiness = 0 %}
{% endif %}

{# =========================================================
   RETIREMENT CORPUS LINE CHART — DATA POINTS
   Build a year-by-year projection from current age to 60
   ========================================================= #}

{% set chart_ages = [] %}
{% set chart_projected = [] %}
{% set chart_required = corpus_required %}

{% set monthly_rate_chart = 0.09 / 12 %}
{% set start_corpus = financial_assets %}
{% set start_sip = monthly_surplus %}

{% for age_offset in range(0, years_to_retirement + 1) %}
    {% set months_elapsed = age_offset * 12 %}

    {# Future value of starting corpus #}
    {% set fv_start = start_corpus * ((1 + monthly_rate_chart) ** months_elapsed) %}

    {# Future value of monthly SIP #}
    {% if monthly_rate_chart > 0 %}
        {% set fv_sip = start_sip * (
            ((1 + monthly_rate_chart) ** months_elapsed - 1) / monthly_rate_chart
        ) %}
    {% else %}
        {% set fv_sip = start_sip * months_elapsed %}
    {% endif %}

    {% set total = fv_start + fv_sip %}

    {# Append to lists #}
    {% set _ = chart_ages.append(current_age + age_offset) %}
    {% set _ = chart_projected.append(total) %}
{% endfor %}

{# Find the max value for Y-axis scaling #}
{% set chart_max = [
    (chart_projected | max if chart_projected else 0),
    corpus_required,
    1
] | max %}


{# =========================================================
   ASSET PERCENTAGES
   ========================================================= #}

{% set financial_pct  = (financial_assets / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}
{% set realestate_pct = (real_estate / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}
{% set business_pct   = (business_assets / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}
{% set other_pct      = (other_assets / total_assets * 100) if total_assets else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   CASH FLOW BAR HEIGHTS
   ========================================================= #}

{% set max_cf = [monthly_income, monthly_expenses, monthly_emi, monthly_surplus] | max %}

{% set income_bar  = (monthly_income  / max_cf * 100) if max_cf else 0 %}
{% set expense_bar = (monthly_expenses / max_cf * 100) if max_cf else 0 %}
{% set emi_bar     = (monthly_emi     / max_cf * 100) if max_cf else 0 %}
{% set surplus_bar = (monthly_surplus / max_cf * 100) if max_cf else 0 %}


{# =========================================================
   FAMILY / DEPENDENT
   ========================================================= #}

{% set family_profile = namespace(occupation="-", dependents=0) %}

{% for family_row in (doc.family_and_dependent_details or []) %}

    {% set relation_value = (family_row.relation or "")|string|lower %}

    {% if relation_value in ["self", "client", "applicant"] and family_row.occupation %}
        {% set family_profile.occupation = family_row.occupation %}
    {% endif %}

    {% set dependent_value = (family_row.dependent or "")|string|lower %}

    {% if dependent_value in ["yes", "y", "true", "1"] %}
        {% set family_profile.dependents = family_profile.dependents + 1 %}
    {% endif %}

{% endfor %}

    <div class="page-title">Financial Assessment Report</div>
    <div class="page-subtitle">Comprehensive Personal Financial Assessment</div>

    <div class="callout success">
        <div class="callout-title">Executive Summary</div>
        Net worth is
        <strong>₹ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(net_worth) }}</strong>,
        with a monthly surplus of
        <strong>₹ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(monthly_surplus) }}</strong>
        ({{ "%.1f"|format(savings_rate) }}% of income).
        The strongest area is savings rate; the area needing most attention is insurance cover.
    </div>

    <div class="cards">

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Net worth</div>
            <div class="card-value">₹ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(net_worth) }}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-gap"></div>

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Monthly surplus</div>
            <div class="card-value">₹ {{ "{:,.0f}".format(monthly_surplus) }}</div>
            <div class="card-status good">Good</div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-gap"></div>

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Savings rate</div>
            <div class="card-value">{{ "%.1f"|format(savings_rate) }}%</div>
            <div class="card-status {{ 'good' if savings_rate >= 20 else 'watch' }}">
                {{ 'Good' if savings_rate >= 20 else 'Watch' }}
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>

    <div style="height: 8px;"></div>

    <div class="cards">

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Emergency fund</div>
            <div class="card-value">{{ "%.1f"|format(emergency_months) }} months</div>
            <div class="card-status {{ 'good' if emergency_months >= 6 else 'watch' }}">
                {{ 'Good' if emergency_months >= 6 else 'Watch' }}
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-gap"></div>

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Debt-to-income</div>
            <div class="card-value">{{ "%.1f"|format(debt_to_income) }}%</div>
            <div class="card-status {{ 'good' if debt_to_income <= 36 else 'action' }}">
                {{ 'Good' if debt_to_income <= 36 else 'Action' }}
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-gap"></div>

        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-label">Retirement readiness</div>
            <div class="card-value">{{ "%.0f"|format(retirement_readiness) }}%</div>
            <div class="card-status {{ 'good' if retirement_readiness >= 100 else 'watch' }}">
                {{ 'Good' if retirement_readiness >= 100 else 'Watch' }}
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>


    <!-- FINANCIAL HEALTH SCORE BAR CHART -->

    <div class="section" style="margin-top: 18px;">

        <div class="section-heading">
            Financial health score by area
        </div>

        <div class="hbar-chart">

            {% set scores = [
                ("Savings rate", 100 if savings_rate >= 20 else (savings_rate / 20 * 100)),
                ("Emergency fund", 100 if emergency_months >= 6 else (emergency_months / 6 * 100)),
                ("Debt burden", 100 if debt_to_income <= 36 else (100 - (debt_to_income - 36) * 2)),
                ("Insurance cover", 65),
                ("Retirement readiness", retirement_readiness),
                ("Diversification", 100 if largest_asset_share <= 60 else (100 - (largest_asset_share - 60) * 1.5))
            ] %}

            {% for label, score in scores %}

                {% set s = [score, 0]|max %}
                {% set s = [s, 100]|min %}

                <div class="hbar-row">

                    <div class="hbar-label">
                        {{ label }}
                    </div>

                    <div class="hbar-track">

                        <div
                            class="hbar-fill {{ 'watch' if s < 80 else '' }}"
                            style="width: {{ s }}%;"
                        ></div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="hbar-value">
                        {{ "%.0f"|format(s) }}
                    </div>

                </div>

            {% endfor %}

        </div>

    </div>
